newsitem.title: USA: JPE Q4 loss stems from lower oper profit.
newsitem.headline: JPE Q4 loss stems from lower oper profit.

text.p: JPE Inc said Tuesday a sharp decline in operating profit in the fourth quarter ended December 31 contributed to a loss in the period despite an increase in sales.

The company reported a loss of $477,000, or $0.10 a share, compared to net income of $963,000, or $0.23 a share a year ago. Operating profit in the quarter fell to $1.4 million from $3.2 million in the last quarter of 1995, the company said.
Sales rose to $47.7 million from $44.6 million a year ago.
JPE buys companies that make auto and truck components for original equipment manufacturers and for the aftermarket.
